summary: This directory is responsible for the operational execution of JSDoc update tasks. It bridges the gap between planned documentation changes and their application to the codebase, ensuring that generated modification strategies are correctly performed by the AI model.
responsibilities: Apply documentation changes to source files
Verify the successful execution of update operations
relationships: The execution engine processes a JSDoc update plan to perform modifications on target files.
Documentation modification results are validated against the defined update plan to ensure accuracy.
designDecisions: Isolation of execution logic from plan generation
